description_en: Queries a list of scan tasks. This operation retrieves scan records under a specified project with pagination
description_zh: 扫描任务的列表查询接口，用于分页获取某个项目下的扫描记录
name: DescribeScans

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量。默认 20，最大支持 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter or set it to an empty string for the first page. For subsequent pages, pass the nextToken value from the previous response without any modification. If the nextToken in the response is empty, the last page has been reached
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token，首页不传 nextToken 省略或为空字符串，翻页原样回传把上一次响应的 nextToken 值不做任何修改地传入下一次请求，响应中 nextToken 为空，已到最后一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

running: The task is running.
completed: The task is completed.
failed: The task failed
parameters.help_zh:
状态取值：
running：运行中
completed：已完成
failed：失败
parameters.name: status
